description: This file defines a custom exception class CartItemModifyException used in the 'order' shopping cart component of the OFBiz framework. It extends the GeneralException class and provides multiple constructors for exception handling.

classes.name: CartItemModifyException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate errors during modification of cart items within the shopping cart process.

methods.name: CartItemModifyException()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an instance without a specific message or cause.

methods.name: CartItemModifyException(String str)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message to be specified.

methods.name: CartItemModifyException(Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor allowing an underlying cause (throwable) to be specified.

methods.name: CartItemModifyException(String str, Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor allowing both a custom message and a cause to be specified.
